versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Archive Smart Reader (智能压缩文件阅读器)
- Directly reads and previews contents of zip, tar, gz, tgz, bz2, xz, 7z, and rar archives without manual extraction
- Lists, previews, searches, and extracts files, with support for direct image viewing from archives
- Automatically learns from each use: adapts performance, remembers user preferences, and improves error handling
- Supports smart format detection (even without extensions) and automatic dependency installation for uncommon formats
- Provides convenient Python scripts for listing, previewing, and extracting archive contents
